sanskrit_verse:
हेममात्रम् उपादाय रूपं वा हेमकारकः ।
निजलालासमायोगात् कोशं वा कोशकारकः ॥
transliteration:
hemamātram upādāya rūpaṃ vā hemakārakaḥ /
nijalālāsamāyogāt kośaṃ vा kośakārakaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who takes possession of gold alone, or its form, becomes a goldsmith by virtue of personal effort and conscious engagement; similarly, one who assumes the silken thread becomes the spinner through intentional labor.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from direct assumption of material cause
Causation is established through volitional identification with substance
Capacity-based responsibility derives from embodied engagement
Restoration logic operates via reintegration into source-consciousness
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity assumes control over raw material THEN assign craft-based identity AND bind to causal chain of production
IF individual identifies with instrumental role THEN activate duty-bound status within occupational framework
IF ownership claim is made THEN verify experiential engagement AND establish proportional accountability
IF skill-based action initiates THEN recognize inherent capacity AND enforce completion protocol
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving artisanal rights or intellectual-property claims rooted in manual creation, the threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable, intentional interaction with base materials. The court must assess not mere possession but conscious labor that aligns identity with outcome. Authority flows from this ontological integration rather than abstract title.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that transformation follows from deliberate contact. Anupūrvaśaḥ affirms sequential emergence: touch → shaping → ownership. Proportional responsibility correlates with depth of identification. Non-punitive reality holds because misalignment results in natural disqualification from craft-status until realignment occurs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Realign artisan with original material to restore integrity
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm experiential mastery before granting craft-title
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reintegrate displaced worker into productive flow
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Return false claimant to pre-assumption state for recalibration
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is restored. Justice flows from consciousness alignment, not punitive judgment. The Supreme Adjudicator is ever-present Awareness.
